title: PY-08 Python runtime policy and root compatibility qualification

statements.text: One distribution context owns source policy and root qualification in the existing repository; adjacent runtime owners retain their interfaces and pins.
Retain the root Python 3.12 metadata floor, current Python 3.14 PR/main authority, native protections and every existing compatibility member.
Add standard CPython 3.15 to weekly/manual full macOS qualification with Worktrunk 0.81.0; preserve independent results, current authorities and timeouts.
Review all declared Python runtime owners monthly and assess relevant security releases or advisories urgently, with prioritized fix qualification through the existing owner.
Preserve all isolated and deployed runtime pins, locks, installers, disabled states and activation boundaries; root qualification establishes no isolated runtime qualification.
Keep the existing update runbook as the canonical installer inventory and use its candidate, recovery and separately approved activation procedures.
Repair only demonstrated root 3.15 compatibility issues while preserving 3.12 behavior, credential isolation and security assertions; the known credential fixture needs supported module loading.

Require explicit requested/observed interpreter identities, frozen root lock evidence, focused oldest/newest regressions, an exact-source full manual candidate matrix and all current required checks before qualification.

No support-floor increase, PR promotion, experimental interpreter target, dependency upgrade, checker migration, new runtime manager, registry, updater, scheduler or live environment activation is selected.
Additional dependency or fixture incompatibilities, wrong child interpreter, runtime cost and optional skips remain qualification risks; failures are preserved without broad skips or invented passes.

Preserve unmerged Discovery authority and import the complete changed-document closure through the existing receipt/preflight route from a clean approved-base Build checkout; exact launch approval precedes registration.
On compatibility regression preserve failed evidence, prioritize bounded repair and rerun the full matrix; review completion and maintenance handoff use existing private lifecycle evidence.
